prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: north-star mobile app decision comp, exact final viewport 390 × 844 pixels, portrait.
Primary request: Create a polished, production-realistic first viewport for the Nino Consumer package builder, visual direction ‘Bancada modular’. This is a white-label Brazilian restaurant ordering interface, not marketing art. The whole viewport must look like a compact kitchen mise en place: every option group is a clearly separated stacked module, all groups visible at once, each showing its quantity, chosen products, and a completed state. A compact order summary stays attached above a bottom action and shows the closed package price.
Structure from top to bottom: 1) very compact white top bar with back chevron, small restaurant wordmark ‘Nino Burger’, and a subtle ‘Pacote’ label; 2) heading region: eyebrow ‘MONTE SEU PACOTE’, bold title ‘Seu combo, do seu jeito’, one concise line ‘Escolha 2 hambúrgueres e 2 bebidas.’ and tiny progress ‘4 de 4 etapas concluídas’; 3) a warm off-white worktop area containing four compact white modules stacked with 8px gaps, each flat with a fine warm-gray border and 16px radius. Every module has a small orange outlined number tile on the left, title and quantity in the center, selected item(s) listed beneath, and an orange check-in-circle at right: Module 01 title ‘Hambúrgueres’ quantity ‘2 itens’ selections ‘Nino Clássico’ and ‘Cheddar Bacon’; Module 02 title ‘Bebidas’ quantity ‘2 itens’ selections ‘Coca-Cola 350 ml’ and ‘Guaraná 350 ml’; Module 03 title ‘Molhos’ quantity ‘2 itens’ selections ‘Maionese da casa’ and ‘Barbecue’; Module 04 title ‘Ponto da carne’ quantity ‘2 escolhas’ selections ‘Ao ponto’ and ‘Ao ponto’. Each module must visibly read as complete, dense and tappable, with one tiny secondary action ‘Editar’. 4) a sticky white summary panel at the bottom with subtle upward diffuse shadow only here: left side label ‘Pacote completo’, old price ‘de R$ 67,60’ struck through and decisive price ‘R$ 49,90’; right/full-width orange pill action ‘Adicionar à sacola’.
Style/medium: high-fidelity native-feeling mobile ecommerce UI screenshot, crisp UI design, no device frame.
Typography: headings in the character of Bricolage Grotesque, functional text in the character of Hanken Grotesk. Strong compact human headings, highly readable neutral body.
Color palette: page and cards white; worktop background warm off-white #f7f4ef; strong text warm charcoal #645e56; secondary text #777067; fine borders #e8e1d8; brand orange #ff6b00 used only for selected/completed states and the primary action.
Materials/textures: flat digital surfaces; no photography and no illustrative decoration.
Text (verbatim): ‘Nino Burger’; ‘Pacote’; ‘MONTE SEU PACOTE’; ‘Seu combo, do seu jeito’; ‘Escolha 2 hambúrgueres e 2 bebidas.’; ‘4 de 4 etapas concluídas’; ‘01’; ‘Hambúrgueres’; ‘2 itens’; ‘Nino Clássico’; ‘Cheddar Bacon’; ‘02’; ‘Bebidas’; ‘2 itens’; ‘Coca-Cola 350 ml’; ‘Guaraná 350 ml’; ‘03’; ‘Molhos’; ‘2 itens’; ‘Maionese da casa’; ‘Barbecue’; ‘04’; ‘Ponto da carne’; ‘2 escolhas’; ‘Ao ponto’; ‘Editar’; ‘Pacote completo’; ‘de R$ 67,60’; ‘R$ 49,90’; ‘Adicionar à sacola’.
Constraints: mobile-first portrait composition; all four option modules must be visible within the first viewport; compact but touch-friendly rhythm; one flat coherent app screen; warm restrained white-label identity; hierarchy suitable for implementation in HTML/CSS; exact Brazilian Portuguese copy; no status bar needed; no bottom navigation; no cropping of the sticky summary.
Avoid: gradients, glassmorphism, frosted effects, generic decoration, food photos, illustrations, excessive orange, orange section backgrounds, ornamental shadows, floating cards, dashboard aesthetics, desktop layout, device bezel, watermark, extra products, add-ons, extras, badges, promotional claims, illegible or invented text.
